description: Things to do on one day near one US town (trivia, live music, karaoke, comedy, games, markets, talks and more), each checked against the page it came from. Give the town the person asked about ("Denver, CO", "Tampa, FL" or "Sacramento, CA") or a 5-digit ZIP, a date, and optionally a kind of event. With no town, the rough town the app shares is used, if it shares one. Read-only: it changes nothing. US events only, at most 25 per call, soonest first. Each result has its own Suumer page to cite (suumerPage), and the original source page when we can show it.

date.description: The day, written YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out for today in that town.

kind.description: Kind of event. Leave it out (or "all") for everything. live_music covers concerts, bands, orchestras and choirs.

town.description: The US town and state the person asked about, like "Denver, CO", "Tampa, FL" or "Sacramento, CA", or a 5-digit ZIP code. Leave it out to use the rough town the app shares.

name: find_events
title: Find local events on Suumer
